players.product: Memory burn-in and test sockets, spring pins, and magnetic collets for HBM die pick-and-place / bonding

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 60,695,918,874 (H1 2025: KRW 45,963,384 thousand) and operating profit KRW 12,000,936,157; Q2 2026 revenue KRW 35,083,034,144 and operating profit KRW 8,394,249,822
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 60,695,918,874 (H1 2025 KRW 45,963,384 thousand); operating profit KRW 12,000,936,157

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue mix: burn-in / test sockets and spring pins KRW 55,777M (91.9%), test services KRW 4,085M (6.7%), other KRW 834M (1.4%). By region: domestic KRW 43,218,623 thousand, China KRW 13,396,970 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 8,471,214 thousand), Singapore KRW 2,452,790 thousand, Hong Kong KRW 899,917 thousand. The company says it has expanded its customer base in China, with revenue from major customers there, built on high-speed, high-density memory socket technology developed with major domestic chipmakers
quarterly_data.figure: sockets KRW 55,777M (91.9%); China KRW 13,396,970 thousand (H1 2025 KRW 8,471,214 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 capacity for burn-in sockets and related products 57,829 thousand units with production of 39,067 thousand units (FY2025: capacity 92,235 thousand, production 54,764 thousand); capacity can be flexed by adding staff and moulds
quarterly_data.figure: production 39,067 thousand units vs capacity 57,829 thousand units

quarterly_data.signal: Magnetic collets (consumable pick-up tools for chip pick-and-place, entered in 2018): consumption is tied to customers' chip output, with HBM now the main product; large-capacity memory such as HBM needs ultra-precision collet solutions for bonding, and the company is developing collets for hybrid bonding (new materials, heat resistance, design, pick-and-place)

New products: developing high-speed memory test solutions for DDR5 server DRAM, preparing mass production of test-interface products for LPCAMM and SOCAMM modules, and has completed a CXL-based test design to enter that market; a test-board connector for fine-pitch wafer test equipment is growing new-business sales

Customer concentration (customers not named in the note): customers above 10% of H1 2026 consolidated revenue - Customer 1 KRW 11,385,991 thousand, Customer 2 KRW 9,557,686 thousand, Customer 3 KRW 6,226,257 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 8,938,890 thousand, KRW 15,360,438 thousand and KRW 3,948,374 thousand)
quarterly_data.figure: Customer 1 KRW 11,385,991 thousand; Customer 2 KRW 9,557,686 thousand; Customer 3 KRW 6,226,257 thousand

Okins Electronics.why: Makes memory burn-in / test sockets (91.9% of H1 2026 revenue) and magnetic collets used in HBM die bonding; consumables whose volume tracks memory and HBM output
Okins Electronics.evidence: Okins Electronics Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026): manufactures burn-in and test sockets supplied to major domestic chipmakers; magnetic collet demand tied to customers' output with HBM now the main product
